output_notes.note: R001/S001–S004 proves every exported clause for arbitrary metric X, A and p>0: cover upper bounds and scale antitonicity, cofinal finite-positive-scale supremum, the two small-cover implications, all sequences of positive scales tending to zero, and exact original H comparison using the actual D018–D019 now in the packet. The reindexing statement includes countable subfamilies and variable finite blocks, with empty padding and nonnegative cost preserved. Its original statement is unchanged and contains what R002/R003 use.

R002/S001–S005 exports the quantitative countable 2r-cover with strict cost <2^(q+2)ε under q>0 and μH[q](A)=0, uniformly in A,r,ε and depending only on q. S006 tests arbitrary positive target scale and tolerance using rTarget=min(1,Δ/2) and εTarget=τ/(2·2^(q+2)), proving the zero-(q+1)-measure clause. No positive actual diameter or nontrivial X is required, including singleton or empty spaces.

R003/S001–S007 proves C_s(δ,A) is below the cost of every admissible product cover, with arbitrary nonmeasurable members and c possibly ∞. S008 infimizes, handles absence of covers by right side ∞, and takes the exact N001 suprema at s,s+1. The exported content and measure inequalities have constant one in maxProd and impose no extra compactness, measurability or nonemptiness premise.

R004/S001 applies dimension monotonicity to A⊆univ V and the exact ambient dimension formula. Nonnegativity comes from the codomain and finrank(V) is a finite natural number. This supplies finiteness and the zero-finrank case to R006.

R005/S001 proves I has an interior point by the radius-1/4 ball around 1/2 and applies M009 in ℝ. The basis {1} gives real finrank one, so the output is dimension exactly one for the original real unit interval.

R006 retains its full quantified nonempty compact premise. S001–S004 obtain the upper bound with finite h before any real subtraction; S005–S007 prove the lower bound for d>0; S008–S009 use the point supplied by nonemptiness and N005 for d=0. S010 closes both exhaustive cases, including finrank(V)=0, and exports equality in the max product for R008.

R007/S001–S004 supplies both coordinate inverse identities, real linearity, finite-dimensional structures, exact image T''Fmax=Feuc and the dimension equality from E001. S004 also proves the two max/Euclidean distance bounds with constants 1 and sqrt(2), independent of n,E and points. All clauses explicitly cover n=0 and are present in the output rather than hidden in its producer.

R008/S001 has the original H001,H002 and the complete N006,N007 as direct inputs. Instantiating N006 with the Euclidean finite-dimensional Vn and E proves dimH(Fmax)=dimH(E)+1; N007 identifies its dimension with the original Feuc in Wn. Substitution is the exact spec.conclusion and full selected Euclidean product theorem, for every n≥0.
